name: Strength And Weakness
overview: Scripture reveals that true strength comes from God, who is everlasting and never grows weary, providing unsearchable wisdom and power to His people (Isaiah 40:28). Believers are called to rely not on their own might but to be strong in the Lord and empowered by His righteous hand (Isaiah 41:10; Ephesians 6:10). Through Christ, who strengthens us, we can face all challenges with confidence, boldly approaching God's throne to receive mercy and grace in times of need (Philippians 4:13; Hebrews 4:16). This strength is further cultivated by the renewing of the mind, aligning believers with God's perfect will rather than conforming to worldly patterns (Romans 12:2).
